column1: Every change to a Workbench reference list or table is a validated load with a version. None needs a code release. Lists read from ACE are not loaded.

column3: The owner of the list or table raises the change with the reason and the date it should take effect
The reference data administrator prepares the new version as a load file, with a test case for each changed row
The load runs against the schema and the completeness checks in SIT. A load with an exception is refused whole
The owner approves. Risk also approves where a limit or a threshold moves
The new version loads into production with its valid from date. No code release
New decisions use the new version from its date. Open cases keep the version they were decided under
A breach returns the previous version through the same load
A list read from ACE through a v_ace_* view is not loaded and not versioned in the Workbench. A change to its values comes from the ACE batch; the Workbench reads the new values on the next request.
